provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A Set-Cookie header without a name=value pair is discarded by the user agent, so no cookie exists that could lack a flag.

groundTruth.rationale: RFC 6265 section 5.2 ignores a set-cookie-string that has no '=' in its first segment. A discarded header stores nothing, so there is no cookie to report.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The discarded header is still an application defect; this family of rules is not the right detector for it.
